sloka: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा वानरेन्द्रस्य धीमतः ।उवाच दुन्दुभिर्वाक्यं रोषात्संरक्तलोचनः ॥४-११-३१॥।।
transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṁ śrutvā vānarendrasya dhīmataḥ ।uvāca dundubhirvākyaṁ roṣātsaṁraktalocanaḥ ॥4-11-31॥।।

translations.english: 'Dundubhi whose eyes turned red in anger when he heard the words of Vali ,the wise king of the monkeys, said:
